The new frontend uses AndroidLiquidGlass liquid glass containers and navigation; the legacy frontend keeps the classic interface. Theme changes apply immediately.
Affects the Steam store search when adding games and the Workshop list language when browsing mods. Simplified Chinese by default.
Check for updates automatically on launch
Checks the latest Release in the background on cold start; stays silent if nothing is new.
APK downloads prefer the selected source; metadata checks fall back to other mirrors and finally to the official GitHub direct link.
No update check has been run yet.
More threads make downloads faster but put more load on the phone.
Allow HTTP requests with Steam login state
The app globally allows cleartext HTTP to match some Workshop CDNs. When disabled, HTTP requests bound to a Steam account are blocked; enabling exposes login state over cleartext links.
Accesses the Workshop following some Steam community forwarding rules for a no-accelerator direct experience.
When enabled, future single-file mod downloads rename the exported file to the mod name, keeping the original extension. If the mod name is not resolved, the original file name is kept.
